cultural_heritage.significance: Emblem of wisdom, steadfast strength, and unbreakable memory. Represents patience and immense physical weight.

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Heavyweight Stomp: Deep crouch with delayed lift; lands with an earth-shaking resonant thud. Ears flap wide and trunk curls upward in triumphant J-salute.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: Heavyweight Anchor (Invariance): When swapped, smaller elements must hop completely over Gaja. Gaja's high numeric values bubble steadily rightward pass-by-pass into the sorted partition.

cultural_heritage.significance: Triumph of knowledge over ignorance (Tamaso ma jyotir gamaya). Inner truth, persistence, and continuous illumination.

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Flame Burst Leap: Rapid, high-frequency spring; its living sculpted S-curve flame stretches and trails warm golden light in the air.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: Traversal Illuminator (Active Comparison): Flame flares into brilliant white-gold when inspecting adjacent pairs; cheek ember pulses warm amber when an inversion is detected.

cultural_heritage.significance: Emblem of fullness, auspicious abundance, and source of life. Adorned with mango leaves (Amrapallava) and sacred coconut (Shriphala).

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Resonant Bell Chime Hop: Solid, balanced metallic leap; the 5 pointed mango leaves flutter rhythmically and coconut tuft sways, landing with a clean temple chime.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: Partition Boundary Buffer (Completion): Marks the sorted partition boundary (n - i - 1). Emits a golden sacred chime when an element reaches its permanent invariant slot.

name: Grantha
title: The Vedic Palm-Leaf Book & Memory Logger

cultural_heritage.significance: Ancient preservation of foundational mathematics (Sulba Sutras, Aryabhatiya). Structured algorithmic records and written memory.

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Leaf Flutter Hop: Crisp upright box spring; carved teak wood covers clap with a gentle wooden snap, and the red braided cord bells chime.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: State & Swap Counter (Memory Logger): Unfurls its ancient manuscript leaves and tilts its peacock quill to log swap state changes and loop counts in memory.

name: Dhanesh
title: The Great Indian Hornbill & Casque Glide

cultural_heritage.significance: Sacred forest bird of the Western Ghats and Northeast India. Embodies aerial vigilance, partnership, and ancient canopy wisdom.

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Casque Glide Leap: High vertical flutter with a slight wing glide at apex; regal golden casque horn leads the jump with a forward head dip.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: Precision Comparator Pointer: Massive golden beak dips down to point directly at the adjacent comparison target, making pairwise checks unmistakably clear.

cultural_heritage.significance: Shy, endangered native Indian wildlife covered in pinecone keratin armor. Symbolizes quiet persistence, defense, and self-contained strength.

powers_and_mechanics.jump_physics: Armored Ball Spring: Low crouch that coils into a tight golden pinecone curve at apex, bouncing cleanly on its muscular counterbalanced tail.
powers_and_mechanics.superpower: Stability Armor (Invariance Lock): Shivers its golden keratin scales and locks in place when two elements are already in sorted order (NoSwap).
